title: Bhopal Metro: BIM Execution Plan, MIDP & TIDP Development
author: BIM Earth Consultancy
excerpt: Establishing a structured BIM management framework for the Bhopal Metro Project through the BEP, MIDP and discipline-specific TIDPs.
content:
**Client:** Fountainhead
**Project:** Bhopal Metro Project
**Consultancy:** BIM Earth Consultancy
**Scope of Work:** BIM Execution Plan (BEP), Master Information Delivery Plan (MIDP) & Task Information Delivery Plan (TIDP)

### Project Overview

BIM Earth Consultancy provided BIM management and documentation consultancy services for the Bhopal Metro Project, focusing on the development of structured BIM execution and information delivery plans. The objective was to establish a clear framework for BIM implementation, information management, coordination, and deliverable requirements throughout the project lifecycle.

### Scope of Services

The key services delivered by BIM Earth Consultancy included:

- Preparation and development of the BIM Execution Plan (BEP).
- Development of the Master Information Delivery Plan (MIDP).
- Preparation of discipline-specific Task Information Delivery Plans (TIDPs).
- Establishment of BIM roles, responsibilities, workflows, and information exchange procedures.
- Definition of BIM deliverables, project milestones, and information requirements.
- Development of a structured framework for coordination between project disciplines.
- Alignment of information delivery with project requirements and BIM standards.
- Supporting effective BIM collaboration and information management across the project team.

### Project Outcome

BIM Earth Consultancy successfully developed the BEP, MIDP, and TIDP documentation for the Bhopal Metro Project, providing a structured framework for BIM implementation and coordinated information delivery. The documentation helped establish clear responsibilities, deliverables, workflows, and project information requirements, supporting efficient BIM management throughout the project.
